liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (3 reviews): Bobby gets downright Weir'd, creating a sparkling, magical moment; Intense, morphing into a day-glow Tasmanian Devil, unlike 70s versions [8][15][17]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Fluctuates from listless to amazing, with specific energetic sections noted [9]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Features talking drums towards the end [11]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Almost charming, driven by Brent's twinkling fingers [9]
- **Bertha** (1 review): One of the best Berthas the reviewer has ever heard [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-11-13.sbd.miller.95410.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Wonderful sound with palpable band energy, causing goosebumps [16]
- **gd1987-11-13.122189.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 142 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd87-11-13.sbd.miller.13568.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 3.82/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: Phil throws bombs, Mickey uses electronics, Brent fires, Jerry crisp, Bobby spits [6]
- **gd1987-11-13.151112.aud.lohr.vernon.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 145 min [4]

## Around the show

- Billy is seen smiling throughout the performance [6]
- Hosts bought weak liquid LSD, which they sucked on all weekend [12]
- Tighter than the Kaiser shows from earlier that week [13]
- Music Never Stopped differs significantly from the Kaiser 11/8/87 version [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-11-13.sbd.miller.95410.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Maxell XLIIS) DSet 2: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [1]
- **gd1987-11-13.122189.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Maxell XLIIS)Set 2: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]. Also: Fixed swapped channels in Set 1; pitch correction helped by Joe B. Jones [2]
- **gd87-11-13.sbd.miller.13568.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD -> Cm -> Cass -> Sony SBM1(Modified) -> VX Pocket -> Samplitude -> Cool Edit Pro -> SHN [3]
- **gd1987-11-13.151112.aud.lohr.vernon.flac2496**: taped by Gesine Lohr; transferred by Matt Vernon; source: Unspecified mics (Nak 100?) > unspecified deck (D6?) > MAC [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1987-11-13 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1987-11-13-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [19]
